children: Ukraine's central bank may cut its forecast for gross domestic product growth to 1.1-1.2% this year, from its previous target of 1.8%, due to intensified Russian airstrikes on Ukrainian businesses, officials said on Thursday.
Over summer Russia stepped up its drone and missile attacks on Ukraine, hitting its key economic sectors and effectively blocking exports from the Ukrainian Black Sea ports.
